body.name: Width-two transition vertices
body.construction:
Let \(A_H^{?}\) be the uncertain-labelled arcs of \(H^{\mathrm{aux}}\).  Since the labelling in Definition~\ref{def:width-two-auxiliary-network} is injective, write \(a_e\) for the unique arc labelled by \(e\).  Set
\[
 W^{\mathrm{proj}}=\{\sigma,t\}\cup\{u_e:a_e\in A_H^{?}\}.
\]
